name: spell_book
verifies: par-magic: G3 learned spells and the spell book — a found It_Spell_* of an unlearned spell stays grey-less but cannot be readied or put on the quick bar; teaching (TeachingService → LearnSpell) makes it castable and gives its stack; key B opens IDD_PAGE_SPELLS_2 with the Innos/Adanos/Beliar grids; a number key puts a learned spell on the quick bar; Enter readies it (page closes, blue tile); save/load keeps it
notes: Look at Docs/screens/spell_book_page.png: G3_HUD_View_Spellboook_Back, headers HL_Innos/HL_Adanos/HL_Beliar, Fireball in colour with digit 3, Lightning bolt in colour (carried, not learned), the rest grey; the spell box shows name, description, INT and 'Mana: 15 - 30'. After ready=1 the quick bar cell 3 is blue.
